title: Malicious SHA-256 file hash c283ec4b601b… (OffSeq Mirage)
description: A malicious file identified by the SHA-256 hash c283ec4b601b124d0f73a6c3dc9b90dc0cc8530257882ef87f4c65dff8290200 was observed by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors on 2026-11-16. This file was seen 7 times in attacker activity involving the T1105 technique (Ingress Tool Transfer) originating from attacker infrastructure in the Netherlands. The file hash corresponds to a specific malicious payload such as a dropper, web shell, miner, or post-exploitation tool used during the attack. Organizations are advised to match this hash against files in their environments and security tools.
